name: Tang Ying
bio: Official of the Qing court who worked at the imperial kilns at Jingdezhen from 1728 and directed them from 1736. He ran the enamel colours and the range of forms for the Yongzheng and Qianlong emperors.

milestones.event: Went to Jingdezhen to help to run the imperial kilns.
Became the director of the imperial kilns.
